'''Naarud Nyydo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] criminal living during the [[Galactic War]]. Imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Nyydo was forcibly drafted into the [[Project Noble Focus]], which forced alien inmates of different species to compete against each other to learn their strenths and weaknesses. However, around [[3641 BBY]] a [[Invasion of Belsavis|riot]] broke out and many of the prisoners involved in the project got free. In particular, Nyydo and his fellow Gand went insane, hunting down those responsible for their torture. They captured many colleagues of Doctor [[Everis]], on whose behest a Republic citizen freed the prisoners and killed the Gand, including Nyydo.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Naarud Nyydo appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Boss during the heroic mission "A Lesson is Learned".
